summary_cold.worker_source:
"""Cold direct-helper measurement: no NumPy import before the timed call."""
import argparse
import gc
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import resource
import sys
import time

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--checkout', required=True)
parser.add_argument('--length', type=int, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--kind', choices=['concrete', 'mixed'], required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
sys.path.insert(0, args.checkout)
from cdskit import codonutil

assert 'numpy' not in sys.modules
assert 'cdskit.codonarray' not in sys.modules
pattern = 'ATGCCGTAA' if args.kind == 'concrete' else ''.join(['ATG', 'CCG', 'TAR', 'tga', 'NNN', '---', '??.', 'TAN', 'CGN', 'acg'])
sequence = (pattern * ((args.length + len(pattern) - 1) // len(pattern)))[:args.length]
assert len(sequence) % 3 == 0
assert 'numpy' not in sys.modules
gc.collect()
usage_before = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
cpu_start = time.process_time()
wall_start = time.perf_counter()
summary = codonutil.summarize_codons(sequence, 1, 'last_evaluable')
wall = time.perf_counter() - wall_start
cpu = time.process_time() - cpu_start
usage_after = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF)
result = {
    'checkout': args.checkout, 'length_nt': args.length, 'kind': args.kind,
    'cpu_s': cpu, 'wall_s': wall,
    'peak_rss_bytes': usage_after.ru_maxrss if sys.platform == 'darwin' else usage_after.ru_maxrss * 1024,
    'input_peak_rss_bytes': usage_before.ru_maxrss if sys.platform == 'darwin' else usage_before.ru_maxrss * 1024,
    'numpy_loaded_before': False, 'numpy_loaded_after': 'numpy' in sys.modules,
    'summary': summary, 'summary_keys': list(summary), 'summary_types': [type(v).__name__ for v in summary.values()],
    'sequence_sha256': hashlib.sha256(sequence.encode('ascii')).hexdigest(),
    'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(codonutil.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'python': sys.version, 'platform': platform.platform(),
}
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
